orders.thesis: Gapped about +25% intraday on what looks like an earnings reaction on heavy volume, from a steady uptrend and above prior highs. Post-earnings drift tends to continue modestly after large positive gaps. I can't see the news, so I'm sizing small.

summary: First session with no news access, run late with fills at the close. The digest showed large earnings-style gaps. NOW -24% and FTNT -20% pulled other software names down (WDAY, CRM). GOOGL fell about 12%. GKOS rose about 25% and CROX about 21%. I opened a small GKOS position (6%) as a post-earnings-drift trade. I skipped the software and GOOGL dips because I can't verify the reasons for the drops. Next session: check how GKOS held its gap and whether NOW and FTNT stabilised. Consider CROX or GOOGL only if price action is clear. Keep cash high unless there's a clear setup.
